caseNameFull: Hartigan, Attorney General of the State of Illinois v. Zbaraz

opinions.text: C. A. 7th Cir. [Probable jurisdiction postponed, ante, p. 881.] Motion of Legal Defense Fund for Unborn Children for leave to file a brief as amicus cu*1004riae denied. Motion of Alan Ernest to allow counsel to represent children unborn and born alive denied.
